description: Pycontrails is Contrails.org and the Breakthrough Energy Foundation's Python library for modelling aviation climate effects. It provides common flight and meteorology data structures, aircraft-performance and emissions models, and contrail calculations including CoCiP. Inputs are flight trajectories, aircraft information, meteorological fields and model settings; outputs include contrail evolution, emissions and radiative-forcing quantities. Geographic coverage follows the flight and weather data. Source is free under Apache-2.0, while external meteorological services and optional aircraft-performance databases have separate access terms. A limitation is that results depend on humidity, flight data and model assumptions; a computed climate effect is not a verified operational saving. Pycontrails can compare aviation-operation scenarios within transport and climate simulations. ERA5 (data-era5-reanalysis) is one related meteorological source documented by the project. Public examples explain complete flight-based runs. No flight records, meteorological data or optional commercial database was obtained.
